components.name: 侧边栏
components.purpose: 提供一级导航、当前会话概览和全局工作模式切换

sections: saved views or recent entry slot

visual_rules.active_state: left accent bar plus tinted fill

interaction_rules: active item must remain visible during scroll
hover changes background and label contrast only
collapsed mode is optional but not default in MVP
content_rules: labels should be short and task-oriented
do not show more than 7 primary items
P1 items must feel secondary
accessibility: icon-only collapsed mode needs aria labels

components.name: 顶栏
components.purpose: 承载全局时间范围、筛选、快捷查询、导入和导出操作

zones: left: page title or view context
right: quick query, import, export, density toggle

interaction_rules: import and export stay visible at all times
filters open as anchored overlays instead of full-screen modals
query field supports examples and recent prompts
content_rules: avoid overcrowding with low-value icons
show active filter count near filter trigger
session name should be readable but not dominant

components.name: 指标卡
components.purpose: 帮助用户在首屏快速判断当前是否存在明显性能异常
interaction_rules: entire card is clickable when drill-down exists
hover uses border and contrast shift, not scale
delta and severity must be distinguishable at a glance
content_rules: one metric per card
use concise labels
show units explicitly
if no delta exists, replace with contextual note rather than placeholder
accessibility: large text contrast remains above minimum threshold

components.name: 时间线
components.purpose: 在高密度事件数据中支持缩放、拖拽、定位和钻取
interaction_rules: zoom via wheel and toolbar controls
brush selection creates linked filtering context
hover reveals compact tooltip
click opens details sidebar
dense clusters auto-aggregate before pixel overlap becomes unreadable
content_rules: lanes grouped by thread or module
show aggregation count when collapsed
maintain visible time scale during navigation
performance_rules: Canvas is preferred render surface in MVP
DOM overlays should be limited to tooltip and interactive brush layer
animation must be disabled during heavy redraw
accessibility: selection summary should also be available as text
keyboard zoom and reset controls must exist

components.name: 瓶颈列表
components.purpose: 把复杂性能问题整理成可排序、可行动的优先级清单
interaction_rules: sorting by impact is default
click row opens details and syncs time range
secondary action jumps directly to timeline
supports compact density toggle
content_rules: problem titles must be action-oriented
recommended next step should be one short line
impact score must have comparable scale across rows
accessibility: row focus is visible in keyboard navigation

components.name: 数据表
components.purpose: 提供大数据量下的工程化验证、筛选、排序和导出能力
interaction_rules: supports virtual scrolling
column resizing and hiding are inline actions
sorting feedback must be immediate and visible
row selection syncs details sidebar
content_rules: numbers are right-aligned
monospace is used for ids, timestamps and raw values
long text truncates but expands on demand
show current filter and result count in toolbar
performance_rules: never render full 10k plus rows at once
defer expensive cell formatting until visible
accessibility: selected row remains announced with text state

components.name: 自然语言查询面板
components.purpose: 把自然语言输入转化为结构化分析入口和可验证结论
components.placement: topbar quick entry and dedicated query workspace
interaction_rules: submitting a query should not navigate away immediately
results must include apply and inspect actions
example prompts are concise and domain-specific
content_rules: answer order is conclusion then evidence then next step
avoid conversational filler
every claim should map to visible data source

components.name: 详情侧栏
components.purpose: 承载当前选中事件、瓶颈或查询证据的上下文详情，减少页面跳转

sections: header with object title and severity

interaction_rules: opens on row or event selection
can be pinned or collapsed
related links open synchronized views rather than replacing context
content_rules: summary appears before raw metadata
related jumps should be limited to the most useful three
show evidence provenance when content comes from query result
accessibility: trap focus only when treated as modal overlay
